body: The generated .solace/.gitignore ignores store.db. Make it share store.db and approved, still ignoring SQLite sidecars and local run state. Add a test pinning the generated contents. A decision amending D-58 point 7 and Spec 15 is needed. Left out: task, run and strategy data, store merging, and the import-on-clone path.
title: setup: keep store.db in git
